Godrej Consumer Shares Drop Amidst CEO's Sudden Resignation

Godrej Consumer Products Ltd shares fell by 10%, reaching a 52-week and 3-year low, following the sudden resignation of CEO Sudhir Sitapati. Sitapati stated he felt his task at the company was complete. Godrej Consumer has appointed Aasif Malbari as the new MD & CEO and Vishal Kedia as interim CFO. Analysts attributed the stock's sharp decline to the leadership transition, not an immediate change in business strategy.
